runnerContract: Load <script id="farm-data"> and <script id="farm-logic"> with tests/lib.mjs loadLogic() -> FarmLogic.
For each case: actual = FarmLogic[case.fn](...case.args); pass iff canon(actual) deep-equals case.expected.
canon(): recursively sort object keys, drop keys whose value is undefined; arrays keep order; numbers compared exactly (all money/weights are integers).
Pack arguments are pack ids ('ng-kano' | 'in-bihar') resolved from window.FarmData.packs; nothing else is implicit.
Times are epoch milliseconds. T0 = 1789795800000 = 2026-09-19 06:30 WAT = 05:30Z (start of the simulated day in the ng-kano pack).

Functions never throw for invalid SCALAR input (NaN, negatives, strings, out of range); failures are {ok:false,error:CODE}. Passing null for a required OBJECT argument is a programmer error and may throw TypeError. If your implementation differs from a case, the SPEC formulas win — list it in specConflicts, do not silently change expected values.
